name: @office/intelligence-exceptions
description: Office exception and control-tower engine (OFF-019): the portfolio control tower — deterministic detection of actionable exceptions over the intelligence peers' outputs (the relationship engine's authorization-filtered traversal subgraphs, the margin engine's ImpactAssessment values, the memory engine's outcome/benchmark facts), STABLE seeded prioritization with EXPOSED score composition (severity weight + economic weight over exact rationals, never a black box), evidence-chained severity and economic impact (every exception's evidence chain resolves to the producing source event/assessment/benchmark ids, freeze A4), and SUGGESTED next actions only (typed command references resolvable through the OFF-017 action gateway — the control tower never executes anything). Detection and ranking are pure deterministic typed computation: no AI/LLM/network calls of any kind, no clock, no randomness (injected scan identity + clock). Depends only on @office/contracts (envelopes, EntityRefs, CommandName), @office/domain-kernel (Result/DomainError), @office/authz (deny-by-default exception access), @office/events (LedgerEventId identity — read surface only), @office/intelligence-relationships (traversal subgraphs), @office/intelligence-margin (ImpactAssessment values), and @office/intelligence-memory (exact-rational arithmetic + benchmark facts).
